_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Stay In Tarkov egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs and the Single Player Tarkov egg in https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-standalone (MIT).
name: Single Player Tarkov
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The server for SPT, the offline Escape from Tarkov mod, with Fika for co-op if you turn it on. Installs the chosen SPT release's Linux server, checked against GitHub's checksum; profiles and mods in SPT_Runtime/user are kept.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SPT (Single Player Tarkov): downloads the chosen SPT release's server from
# its GitHub releases, checked against GitHub's SHA-256, and Fika (the co-op
# mod) when it's turned on. Profiles, mods and settings in SPT_Runtime/user
# are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "SPT's server is only built for x86-64 (amd64) CPUs, and this node is $(uname -m)."
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

repo=sp-tarkov/build
want="${SPT_VERSION:-latest}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "SPT has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null || echo 4.1.2)."
read -r asset sum < <(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '$1 ~ /^SPT-.*\.7z$/ { print; exit }') || true
[ -n "${asset:-}" ] || fail "SPT's release $tag has no server download."

if [ "$(cat .raptor-spt 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $sum" ] && [ -f SPT_Runtime/SPT.Server.Linux.dll ]; then
    echo "SPT $tag is already installed."
else
    [ -f SPT_Runtime/SPT.Server.Linux.dll ] || [ ! -f SPT_Runtime/SPT.Server.exe ] ||
        echo "SPT $tag replaces the Windows server that was here; your profiles in SPT_Runtime/user stay."
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    command -v 7z >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends p7zip-full; } >/dev/null ||
        fail "7-Zip couldn't be installed to unpack SPT. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading SPT $tag, about 150 MB"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/spt.7z" || fail "The download of SPT failed. Reinstall to try again."
    7z x -bd -y -o"$build/x" "$build/spt.7z" 'SPT_Runtime/*' >/dev/null || fail "The download of SPT is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -f "$build/x/SPT_Runtime/SPT.Server.Linux.dll" ] || fail "SPT $tag has no Linux server. Choose 4.0 or newer."
    # Your profiles and mods stay; the server and its data are replaced.
    rm -rf "$build/x/SPT_Runtime/user"
    mkdir -p SPT_Runtime
    # SPT_Data is the release's own; your edited configs in it are saved first.
    if [ -d SPT_Runtime/SPT_Data/configs ]; then
        old=$(cut -d' ' -f1 .raptor-spt 2>/dev/null || echo old)
        mkdir -p SPT_Runtime/user
        rm -rf "SPT_Runtime/user/configs-before-$tag"
        cp -a SPT_Runtime/SPT_Data/configs "SPT_Runtime/user/configs-before-$tag"
        echo "Your SPT $old configs were saved to SPT_Runtime/user/configs-before-$tag."
    fi
    rm -rf SPT_Runtime/SPT_Data
    cp -a "$build/x/SPT_Runtime/." SPT_Runtime/
    echo "$tag $sum" > .raptor-spt
fi
mkdir -p SPT_Runtime/user/mods

# fits <version> <range>: whether an SPT version is in a range like ~4.1.3, ^4.1.0 or >=4.1.0.
fits() {
    local v=$1 op=${2%%[0-9]*} min=${2#"${2%%[0-9]*}"} a b
    IFS=. read -r a b _ <<<"$min"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$min" "$v" | sort -V | head -n1)" = "$min" ] || return 1
    case $op in
    "~") [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$v" "$a.$((b + 1)).0" | sort -V | head -n1)" = "$v" ] && [ "$v" != "$a.$((b + 1)).0" ] ;;
    "^") [ "${v%%.*}" = "$a" ] ;;
    *) true ;;
    esac
}

if [ "${FIKA:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    frepo=project-fika/Fika-Server-CSharp
    fwant="${FIKA_VERSION:-latest}"
    ftag=$(gh-release tag "$frepo" "$fwant" 2>/dev/null) ||
        fail "Fika has no release $fwant. Set Fika version to latest, or to a release such as v2.4.2."
    read -r fasset fsum < <(gh-release assets "$frepo" "$ftag" | awk '$1 ~ /^Fika\.Server.*\.zip$/ { print; exit }') || true
    [ -n "${fasset:-}" ] || fail "Fika's release $ftag has no server download."
    if [ "$(cat .raptor-fika 2>/dev/null)" = "$ftag $fsum" ] && [ -d SPT_Runtime/user/mods/fika-server ]; then
        echo "Fika $ftag is already installed."
    else
        rm -rf "$build/fika"; mkdir -p "$build/fika"
        echo "Downloading Fika $ftag"
        gh-release download "$frepo" "$ftag" "$fasset" "$build/fika.zip" || fail "The download of Fika failed. Reinstall to try again."
        unzip -q "$build/fika.zip" -d "$build/fika"
        dll="$build/fika/SPT_Runtime/user/mods/fika-server/FikaServer.dll"
        [ -f "$dll" ] || fail "Fika's download has no server mod in it."
        # The SPT versions this Fika is for, as the mod declares them (such as ~4.1.3).
        range=$(perl -0777 -ne 'while (/((?:[~^>=<]\x00)+(?:[0-9]\x00)+\.\x00(?:[0-9]\x00)+\.\x00(?:[0-9]\x00)+)/g) { ($r = $1) =~ s/\x00//g; print "$r\n"; last }' "$dll")
        spt=$(sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+).*/\1/' <<<"$tag")
        if [ -n "$range" ] && ! fits "$spt" "$range"; then
            fail "Fika $ftag is for SPT $range, and SPT $spt is installed. Set Fika version to an older Fika release made for SPT $spt, or Version to a newer SPT."
        fi
        # Fika's settings, written by the mod on its first start, stay.
        cp -a "$build/fika/SPT_Runtime/." SPT_Runtime/
        echo "$ftag $fsum" > .raptor-fika
    fi
fi
echo "Installed SPT $tag$( [ "${FIKA:-0}" = 1 ] && echo " with Fika $ftag")."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The SPT release to install, 4.0 or newer, such as 4.1.2, or latest. Players need the same SPT version.

variables.name: Fika
variables.description: Install Fika, the co-op mod, so friends can play raids together.

variables.name: Fika version
variables.description: The Fika release to install, such as v2.4.0, or latest. It must be one made for the installed SPT version.
